Question: I run a transportation business i.e. I carry goods from one place to another in our trucks or rented trucks, can I transport goods containing cigarettes/pan masala as i have read that smoking cigarettes an eating pan masala is haraam in Islam. Answer ID: 3229 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 182/178=B) Smoking or consuming pan masala is not haram (strictly forbidden) but only makrooh (undesirable); therefore it is allowed to earn through its transportation, the money earned through it shall be lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
